messages:
julia: Heads up — rwd-2026.3 is scheduled for the 11:30 changewindow in ~20m. Preflight evals finished; deploy-bot posted results. @sam @maria @ops-oncall please eyeball, will decide quick.

deploy-bot: Preflight report for rwd-2026.3 (eval-suite: prompt_reg_suites/v1)
```
Summary-gen: quality delta -6.8% (threshold -5.0%)
Hallucination rate: +1.1pp (threshold +0.5pp)
Route impacted: summarizer-prod
Failed prompt clusters: long-thread-summary (45%), ref-attribution (30%)
```
sam: Yikes. 6.8% > 5% threshold. Which exact prompts are pulling the delta? link: https://releases.redwood/evals/1715123456/results
alex: I exported the failing examples — most are from long-thread-summary set. Outputs truncate or swap speaker attribution on long context. I repro locally against rwd-2026.3 quantized-q4 variant.
mike: Short question: can we hold just the summarizer route and let the rest of the rollout continue? Prefer not to pause entire release.
julia: Options: 1) short hold + run expanded eval + bisect quantization path, then unhold if ok; 2) immediate route-level pin back to rwd-2026.2 to keep prod stable and open hotfix. Need quick call.
mike: I'm leaning route-level pin. Safer for customers.
deploy-bot: Routing control supports per-route pin. Example CLI to pin:
```
rwctl route pin --route summarizer-prod --model rwd-2026.2 --reason "preflight regression" --duration 2h
```
maria: I can spin up an expanded eval with +40 edge-case prompts and a targeted bisect on quantization (q4 vs q5) — should take ~45m. If regression is quant-related we can rebuild with q5 and smoke test.
julia: Plan: ops will apply a route-level pin to summarizer-prod to rwd-2026.2 now. Maria runs expanded eval. If expanded eval passes (<5% delta) within 1h we unpin and resume promotion; if it fails we'll create a rollback/hotfix ticket and keep pin until fix. @ops-oncall can you execute the pin?
ops-oncall: Executing route pin now. Running `rwctl` as in snippet. Will annotate release notes.
deploy-bot: Action taken: route pin applied by ops-oncall at 1715123468. Pin expiry set to +2h (171512 \/ expires-epoch trimmed for logs). Reason: preflight regression on prompt suite.
julia: Adding a release-notes blurb: "Deployment held for summarizer route due to preflight eval regression; route pinned to previous model to maintain continuity. Investigating quantization path." @sam please add to release notes and notify stakeholders.
maria: Starting expanded eval run now (includes extra long-thread and attribution prompts). ETA ~40m, will post metrics and sample diffs here.
(40m later)
maria: Expanded eval complete. New delta: summary-gen -3.2% (within threshold), hallucination +0.4pp (within threshold). Root cause: q4 quantization inference path amplifies truncation on long contexts. Rebuild with q5 expected to address.
julia: Good. Proposal: trigger q5 build for rwd-2026.3, run quick smoke against the expanded suite; if smoke passes, unpin summarizer-prod and resume rollout. If smoke fails, follow hotfix rollback path and open ticket. @sam please coordinate release notes update and schedule the q5 build.
sam: :thumbsup: I'll update release notes to include the hold and the fix plan, and kick off the q5 build. Will post smoke results here.
